scope: Icon-only CLOSED Open in chevron ArrowDown/ArrowUp opening and initial enabled endpoint focus
counterexample: With installed Finder and Cursor, the closed enabled icon chevron has no onKeyDown on current main. ArrowDown or ArrowUp therefore leaves the menu closed. Retained Conductor P9 icon trigger props route those arrows through SLt to open and focus first/last respectively.
proposed_data_shape: One component-local ref of first|last, consumed and reset by the existing open effect; no shared state, timer, IPC or global listener

limitations: Static retained real-app evidence only; no native or physical-key observation
Mounted fixture will mock DOM focus, app preferences and native IPC boundaries

No browser, typecheck, build, dependency installation, package or native runtime executed
